# KPH Stay — Luxury Service Apartments & Resorts

> KPH Stay (Kaghan Hotel & Resorts) operates premium luxury service apartments, resort suites, and vacation rentals in Pakistan's primary travel destinations: Islamabad (Bahria Enclave & Margalla Foothills) and Nathia Gali (Kaghan Valley Highlands).

## Property Overview

- **Canonical Brand Name**: KPH Stay / Kaghan Hotel & Resorts
- **Website**: https://kphstay.com
- **Locations**:
  - **Islamabad**: Asian Arcade, Sector C, Bahria Enclave, Islamabad, Pakistan (Coordinates: 33.6844, 73.2045)
  - **Nathia Gali**: Main Resort Road, Nathia Gali, Abbottabad / Kaghan Valley, KP, Pakistan (Coordinates: 34.0722, 73.3831)
- **Property Types**: 1BHK Executive Apartments, 2BHK Luxury Family Suites, 3BHK Mountain View Penthouses, Studio Apartments.
- **Starting Price Range**: PKR 12,000 to PKR 45,000 per night (Weekly & Monthly rates available).
- **Core Amenities**: High-Speed Wi-Fi, Heated Swimming Pool, 24/7 Security & Concierge, Dedicated Parking, Fully Equipped Kitchens, Panoramic Mountain Views, Smart TV, Hot-Stone Spa Sauna.

## Essential Policies

- **Check-in / Check-out**: Check-in from 14:00 PKT; Check-out by 12:00 PKT.
- **Booking**: Instant online reservation via https://kphstay.com/rooms
- **Cancellation**: Full refund available up to 48 hours before check-in date.
